moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-spatial-parallax-inspector, written here): Three layers BG / CONTENT / UI move ×0.25 / ×0.6 / ×1 of a sideways swing: 0 → +44 px (0.35-1.05 s), hold, → −44 px (1.85-2.75 s), hold, → 0 (3.45-4.15 s), power2.inOut (700-900 ms per move). BG = picture card 188x104, CONTENT = text card 160x84, UI = accent panel 120x64; dashed outlines mark rest positions; a bar readout per layer (optional). Params: swing (±44 px) · factors ([0.25, 0.6, 1]) · moves (0.7-0.9 s, power2.inOut) · holds.
